subject.title: [Feature]:Add configUrl and configButton support in SKILL.md frontmatter

question: Should OpenClaw add a public skill configuration action, and if so should it be arbitrary `configUrl`/`configButton` metadata or a typed action model tied to Skill Cards/ClawHub trust?
rationale: The implementation shape is clear, but making skill-authored URLs actionable in the dashboard is both product-surface design and a UI security-boundary decision that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Design typed action contract first
options.body: Add a named configuration action with explicit URL validation, trust labeling, docs, and tests before exposing it in the dashboard.

options.title: Accept the proposed fields directly
options.body: Implement `configUrl` and `configButton` as optional frontmatter fields, accepting the risk of a narrower one-off metadata contract.

options.title: Keep config links outside dashboard
options.body: Continue using `homepage`, Skill Cards, or ClawHub pages for discovery and decline a dashboard Configure action for now.

recommendation.title: Design typed action contract first
recommendation.body: Add a named configuration action with explicit URL validation, trust labeling, docs, and tests before exposing it in the dashboard.

likelyOwner.reason: The highest-risk unresolved decision is the dashboard URL trust policy, and this owner has the clearest recent history on that helper.
